who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane stdmodels (V15) under proofs-1113
what: Three Lean traps cost a build round each: `Ordering` under `open Blaze` is ambiguous with `_root_.Ordering`; `if_pos`/`if_neg` are deprecated (warnings fail the gate); `fun e => nomatch e, rest` inside an anonymous constructor parses `nomatch e, rest` as two discriminants.
cost: two VM lake rounds of several minutes each
cause: library names that shadow Lean core names, and Lean syntax that reads a comma greedily
whys: the Blaze namespace reuses Rust paths that collide with Lean core types; the warning-free gate turns deprecations into failures; nothing lists these traps for library authors
class: Lean library code written without a list of known Lean 4.35 traps
prevention: not done: a how-to row listing the traps (qualify `core.cmp.Ordering`, use `ite_eq_left`/`ite_eq_right`/`dite_eq_left`, parenthesize `(nomatch e)`)
workaround: qualify every Rust-path type in full, and parenthesize nomatch
